lead: Everything a person can own that moves people or goods, from cars, motorcycles and bicycles to caravans, boats, aircraft, heritage rail and prams, plus riding gear and vehicle care; organised by vehicle type and body style, with model generations and designs as archetypes, marques in the brand register and classics as a period view.

b.w: Applies across vehicles, boats and aircraft.

b.v: original > restored to factory spec > restomod > replica/continuation
b.w: Archetype standard ladder applied to classic vehicles.

depts.note: By body style, with model generations as archetypes; a By marque view (brand register) and a Classics period view sit over the same kinds.

b.v: matching numbers · factory spec · documented history · restored vs original
b.w: Classic and collector market (auction houses, marque clubs).

b.v: independent reliability surveys · service intervals · parts supply
b.w: QoL buyers; consumer testers such as Which? and Consumer Reports.
